findings.problem: Meaning is preserved, but 'के साथ' is carried over from English 'with'. Hindi रुकना is intransitive and an error is not an accompanying agent, so 'त्रुटि के साथ रुका' reads as a preposition calque rather than native product copy; the idiomatic collocations are causal or temporal ('त्रुटि के कारण रुका' / 'त्रुटि आने पर रुका').
findings.note: The sidecar's 'states that the turn stopped, not why' rule forbids explaining the cause DETAIL (a separate row), not naming that an error ended the turn - the English sentence already names it. If the wave wants to keep a strictly non-causal reading, 'त्रुटि आने पर रुका' is the natural form.
findings.precedent_rejected: No hi precedent for 'with an error' as a status marker: hi:ui.agents.detail.read_state.list_failed_meaning uses 'त्रुटि के साथ जवाब दिया', where के साथ is licensed by the transitive verb जवाब देना - a different construction.

findings.problem: A bare 'बिना X' phrase is clipped at heading position; the fuller category form is 'बिना समूह वाले' (cf. hi:ui.notifications.bulk.asks_hint 'बिना जवाब वाले सवाल'). Weigh against consistency: the shipped hi catalogue already uses the bare form for the same job (hi:ui.chat.tags.untagged 'बिना टैग'), so changing only this one creates a split.
findings.suggested: बिना समूह वाले (only together with बिना टैग -> बिना टैग वाले); otherwise accept the current value
findings.disposition: accepted as-is for consistency with hi:ui.chat.tags.untagged; no change required
